newsitem.title: UK: General Cable in 77 mln stg leaseback deal.
newsitem.headline: General Cable in 77 mln stg leaseback deal.

text.p: Britain's General Cable said on Tuesday that its subsidiary, Yorkshire Cable Group Ltd, had entered into a sale and leaseback arrangement for certain fixed assets for a total consideration of 77 million stg.
The transaction would yield no profit, General Cable said in a statement.

The assets are mainly television and telephony line electronics and associated equipment, the company said. The proceeds will be retained within the business to finance completion of networks by Yorkshire Cable.

The facility has been arranged by NatWest Markets, Lombard Business Finance and Robert Fleming & Co. It is arranged in conjunction with a 325 million stg senior debt facility arranged by Chase Manhattan and Natwest Markets.
A finance lease has been agreed for a period of 10 years with an optional secondary period available. Rental payments are payable annually in advance commencing on December 31, 1996.
Yorkshire Cable has also entered into a conditional agreement with the same parties to lease further electronic equipment in the future.
The additional facility is available for drawing until 2000.
"The sale and leaseback and future leases are being entered into in order to provide cost effective financing for YCG," General Cable said.
